1.w: For the one directing. A Psalm of David. Until when, O YHWH? Will You forget me forever? Until when will You hide Your face from me?

2.w: Until when shall I set counsel in my soul, [and] sorrow in my heart daily? Until when will my enemy be raised high over me?

3.w: Look attentively; answer me, O YHWH my God! Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,

4.w: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him.” My adversaries rejoice because I am shaken.

5.w: Yet I have trusted in Your loving devotion; My heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

6.w: I will sing to YHWH, because He has dealt bountifully with me.
